queries.text: The EU AI Act entered into force in phases to ensure that obligations are implemented only as institutional capacity and technology mature,  (2024, 2027)
The specific deadlines require the following actions: * ** - - ** Prohibited practices (classified as "unacceptable risk") must be stopped. (2024, 2027)
These include social scoring and certain manipulative or exploitation-of-vulnerability uses . (2024, 2027)
* ** - - ** Obligations apply to general-purpose AI (GPAI) models. (2024, 2027)
Duties scaled systemic-risk status using threshold FLOPs
2024 law published Official Journal entered force
Non-compliance can result in fines reaching € million or of global annual turnover (whichever is higher) for prohibited-practice violations, (2024, 2027)

search_hits.title: The EU AI Act's phased entry into force (2024-2027)
search_hits.snippet: The EU AI Act — the world's first comprehensive AI law — entered into force 2024-08-01 with obligations phased through 2027.
